description:
Reads current own marketplace state or configured limits.
Use when: explicit marketplace actions after reading horizon://docs/marketplace.
Not for: automatic trading, price polling or generated replacement operations. Use horizon_get_marketplace_operation to reconcile the original intent.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken.
Side effects: Read only. No automatic refresh or polling.
Returns: {state,serverTime}
Errors: 409 conflicts require explicit reconciliation, never fresh revisions or operation IDs on an unknown outcome. Missing OPERATION_NOT_FOUND does not prove nonexecution. 422 capacity/balance/daily-limit errors preserve atomicity. 429 schedules no retry. Full Inbox returns pending without losing the original item. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

sessionToken.description: Current accessToken sent only as Bearer

userId.description: Active player matching the current session and project
